test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1st December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a unique feature of the Barren Islands?

options.text: The only active volcano in India is present here.
India's largest saltwater lake exists here.
it is home to the primitive Asaro tribe.
it is an uninhabited island in the Indian Ocean.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The only active volcano in India is present here.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Barren Island__

 __
 
• Barren Island is an island located in the **Andaman Sea.**
 
• **The only active volcano in India is present here.**
 
• It is the only confirmed active volcano in the Indian subcontinent.
 
• The first recorded eruption of the volcano dates back to 1787.
 
• This volcanic island stands in the midst of a volcanic belt on the edge of the Indian and Burmese tectonic plates.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Andaman and Nicobar Islands **

 
 
• It is a union territory of India consisting of** 572 islands, of which 38** are inhabited, at the junction of the Bay of Bengal and the Andaman Sea. 
 
• The territory is about** 150 km north of Aceh in Indonesia** and separated from Thailand and Myanmar by the Andaman Sea.
